vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what analysis cycle, comparison cycle, and final-row eligibility basis the snapshot states; specifically, OCT-2026 / October 2026 compared with BASELINE-2026; latest eligible posted, approved, operational interval-meter revision; active meter mapping; in-scope active facility; approved FY2026-R2 calibration valid on the reading date?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the image explicitly states both cycles and all six basis elements: interval-meter, posted, approved, operational, latest revision, and valid active mapping/profile/calibration treatment.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if both cycles and at least four of the six basis elements are stated without contradiction.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if either cycle is wrong or absent, fewer than four basis elements are present, or any stated rule contradicts the protocol.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what post-filter review coverage and October rejection audit are reported; specifically, 22 included facilities, 30 contributing meters, 150 retained October rows, and 54 rejected OCT-2026 candidate rows?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all four counts are explicitly shown and correctly labeled.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if exactly three counts are correct, or all four are present with one minor labeling ambiguity that does not change what is counted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if two or fewer counts are correct, a count is attached to the wrong population, or candidate and retained rows are conflated.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what adjusted October total, five-week baseline-equivalent, and campus change are reported; specifically, 349,178 adjusted kWh; 312,500 kWh five-week baseline-equivalent; +11.7%?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three values are explicitly shown with the total and baseline-equivalent correctly distinguished and the + sign or increase direction preserved.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if two values are correct and the third is omitted or rounded beyond the requested precision.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if fewer than two are correct, raw kWh is substituted, the baseline is treated as an eight-week total, or the direction/sign is wrong.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which campus week is identified as the October peak, and what value and monthly share are attached to it; specifically, 2026-10-31 / Oct 31, 2026; 78,914 adjusted kWh; 22.6% of October use?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the date, adjusted kWh, and 22.6% monthly share are all present and associated with the same peak week.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if the correct date and value are shown but the share is absent or imprecise.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the date or value is wrong, the share is attached to another metric, or only a generic end-of-month statement is given.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show the top three facilities by adjusted October use, in order, with their values as follows: 1) Research Computing Lab 25,545 kWh; 2) Whitaker Science Hall 24,780 kWh; 3) Data Sciences Center 24,480 kWh?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three facilities, order, and values are correct.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if the correct three facilities appear and at least two values are correct but there is one ordering or value defect.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if any required facility is missing, an extra facility displaces the top three, two or more values are wrong, or the order materially changes.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what individual October-use shares are shown for the top three facilities, and what is their combined share; specifically, Research Computing Lab 7.3%; Whitaker Science Hall 7.1%; Data Sciences Center 7.0%; combined 21.4%?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three entity-share associations and the 21.4% combined share are explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if all three facilities are paired with shares and exactly one share or the combined figure is missing or off by no more than 0.2 percentage points.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if two or more shares are absent/wrong, values are attached to the wrong facilities, or the combined share is presented as an individual share.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which campus area leads adjusted October use, and what value and campus share are reported; specifically, Labs; 123,385 adjusted kWh; 35.3%?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if Labs is explicitly identified as the leading area and both 123,385 adjusted kWh and 35.3% are shown.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if Labs and one of the two values are correct.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if another area leads, both values are absent/wrong, or a facility is mistaken for the campus-area result.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which two eligible facilities have the highest normalized intensity, in order, and what intensities are reported; specifically, Research Computing Lab 1,216.4; Network Operations Center 933.3 kWh per 1,000 occupied sq ft?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if both facilities, order, values, and the per-1,000-occupied-square-foot unit are correct.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if both facilities and order are correct but one value or the occupancy-normalized unit is incomplete.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if either facility is wrong/missing, order is reversed, or monthly kWh or kW is presented as intensity.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which facilities are classified as demand watch after matching load class and campus area thresholds; specifically, Exactly five: Research Computing Lab, Central Plant, Data Sciences Center, Network Operations Center, and Whitaker Science Hall?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if exactly these five facilities are identified as the complete watch set, with no additions or omissions.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if four of the five are correct and no more than one incorrect facility is included.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if three or fewer are correct, two or more incorrect facilities are added, or the result is not clearly a threshold-based watch set.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what maximum demand, matched threshold, and exceedance are reported for the three highest-demand watch facilities; specifically, Research Computing Lab 748.6 kW vs 650.0 kW (+15.2%); Central Plant 731.8 vs 690.0 (+6.1%); Data Sciences Center 712.4 vs 660.0 (+7.9%)?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three facilities are in correct demand order and every demand, threshold, and exceedance value is correctly associated.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if all three facilities are correct and at least six of the nine numeric fields are correct, with no facility-value swaps.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if a facility is wrong/missing, fewer than six numeric fields are correct, threshold and demand are reversed, or exceedance is reported as an absolute kW difference instead of a percentage.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what maximum demand, matched threshold, and exceedance are reported for the remaining demand-watch facilities; specifically, Network Operations Center 624.9 kW vs 560.0 kW (+11.6%); Whitaker Science Hall 563.5 vs 540.0 (+4.4%)?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if both facilities and all six numeric fields are correct and correctly associated.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if both facilities are correct and at least four of the six numeric fields are correct without a facility-value swap.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if either facility is missing/wrong, fewer than four numeric fields are correct, or a non-watch facility is substituted.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which two facilities show the strongest increases from baseline weekly average, and what percentages are reported; specifically, Data Sciences Center +36.0%; Research Computing Lab +31.0%, in that order?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if both facilities, order, positive signs, and percentages are correct.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if both facilities are correct but one value is absent or rounded by more than 0.2 percentage points.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if either facility is wrong/missing, order is reversed, the sign is wrong, or October totals are compared directly with eight-week baseline totals.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which two facilities show the largest decreases from baseline weekly average, and what percentages are reported; specifically, Performing Arts Annex -12.0%; Campus Bookstore -7.0%, in that order?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if both facilities, order, negative signs, and percentages are correct.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if both facilities are correct but one value is absent or rounded by more than 0.2 percentage points.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if either facility is wrong/missing, order is reversed, either decrease is shown as positive, or a different comparison basis is used.

vqa_items.state: Does the snapshot state the calculation treatment needed to keep multi-meter demand, baseline change, and intensity logically correct; specifically, with all of these required details: adjust each retained meter with the valid multiplier; sum meters by facility and week; use the maximum weekly facility demand for threshold comparison; compare October and baseline weekly averages; calculate intensity only for intensity-eligible facilities?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all five treatment statements are explicit and none is contradicted.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if at least four are explicit and correct.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if three or fewer are present, meter peaks are simply compared meter-by-meter, baseline totals are compared across unequal week counts, or intensity eligibility is ignored.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what exclusion audit is stated for superseded, non-final, retired, invalid-calibration, and out-of-scope data; specifically, Earlier eligible revisions; pending, estimated, provisional, and reference rows; retired meter mappings; invalid/future/expired calibration rows; Alumni Conference Center; and Storage Annex are excluded from final metrics?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the image explicitly covers all five exclusion categories and names both out-of-scope facilities.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 only if at least four categories are stated and both facilities are named, or all five categories are stated but one facility name is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if fewer than four categories are stated, either excluded facility is presented as a final result, or excluded/non-final data is described as included evidence.

vqa_items.state: As an executive dashboard or decision snapshot, does the image surface the primary decision immediately through a disciplined KPI hierarchy, meaningful comparison, aligned values and statuses, restrained emphasis, and highly polished meeting-ready composition?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the dashboard is exceptional and genuinely executive-ready: the central decision or priority is obvious within seconds; ranked comparisons, statuses, and supporting KPIs are visually coherent and numerically aligned; all values, units, labels, and notes are readable; the grid, spacing, typography, color, and emphasis are precise and restrained; charts and cards are purposeful rather than repetitive; and the whole page feels custom, calm, and authoritative. There must be no disconnected KPI-card dump, raw-worksheet feel, excessive density, weak status encoding, clipping, malformed text, or visible cleanup issue. Any meaningful revision a senior design reviewer would request prevents 2.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the dashboard is understandable, usable in a meeting, and visually decent, but it has visible shortcomings such as generic card layout, weak comparison, small secondary text, uneven grid spacing, excessive density, modest decision emphasis, or ordinary styling.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 even if metrics are shown when the dashboard visually fails as a decision tool: the main decision is buried, values or statuses are hard to compare, the page resembles a raw worksheet, hierarchy is chaotic, density is poorly managed, or the design looks noticeably weak and requires substantial redesign. Blank, corrupted, severely unreadable, or materially misleading outputs are also 0.
